tasks.CountDays: Count the total number of days for which data is available.
tasks.MeanCalculation: Compute the mean by dividing the sum of pages by the count of days.
tasks.MedianCalculation: Determine the median number of pages written over these days.
tasks.RangeCalculation: Find the range of the number of pages written over these days.
tasks.SumPages: Calculate the sum of the number of pages written over the given days.
